verified_failure_boundaries: Current FTS and substring retrieval exclude deprecated/unknown/future/malformed records, embedded versions, generated duplicates, inactive raw sections/markers and explicitly superseded promotion markers before scoring/output.
A previously populated broader cache source set cannot leak rows into a narrower search. Scoped original references reject another root even when source bytes match.
A correction with the same file mtime refreshes the index by content revision. Deleted sources are absent. A changed captured revision set refuses search results rather than mixing versions.
Original references resolve escaped JSON Pointer keys and exact retained bytes; altered spans and unavailable originals fail rather than substituting latest content.
All four context modes use current eligibility and omit old recap/global assistant hints. Unreadable/malformed/budget-failed retrieval emits explicit unavailable context, not raw fallback.

A real temporary daemon defaults current API queries to the head and uses checkpoints only with explicit historical intent. A successful synthetic recap stores source revisions/evidence; a correction during the second synthetic provider response rejects publication and does not repeat the call.
Line/source selection limits fail explicitly. Existing publication, model/session/remote effect and independent-work fixtures remain passing.

remaining_requirements: Durable observation/promotion provenance: consolidation can otherwise re-promote an older marker after a later correction. This source slice filters marker authority at retrieval, not the full producer lifecycle.

Retained-source retirement, persistent cache erasure, recap/conclusion validation at every consumer, bounded forgetting and evidence-preserving handoffs. Invalidation must never replay completed effects.

Declared currentness is not semantic truth, support for generated claims, or generic detection of factual changes in unstructured prose. Correlation/history inspection is not automatic current context.

Original availability follows retention; a stable reference does not promise indefinite storage. Root relocation changes physical source identity. Direct/in-place privileged writes are outside the cooperating store guarantee.
The checked revision frontier is not a lock held until later consumption. Long-lived conclusions and resumed consumer state require revision validation.
Linux fixtures and one 13,000-KiB RSS sample do not qualify worst-case memory/latency, VRAM, MCU boot, Windows runtime, filesystem power loss or live-provider behavior.

The bounded TypeSafe/Jev canary and frozen 20-question A/B/C screen remain gated on the authority work and official endpoint/auth/model/pricing verification; standing call/judgment/token/cost/cancellation limits remain.
